denial_letter:
NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION

Date of Notice: November 9, 2023
Claim: Specialist visit, November 2023
Reason Code: CO-R6

Your claim has been processed with the applicable specialist copayment. Copayments apply to each
specialist visit under Section 3.2. Plan records show the member satisfied the annual
out-of-pocket maximum on October 14, 2023.

You may request an internal appeal within 180 days of this notice.
denial_reason: Your claim has been processed with the applicable specialist copayment. Copayments apply to each specialist visit under Section 3.2. Plan records show the member satisfied the annual out-of-pocket maximum on October 14, 2023.

sub_claims.text: Copayments apply to each specialist visit under Section 3.2.
sub_claims.rationale: The evidence provided does not contain any information about whether the copayments apply in cases where the annual out-of-pocket maximum has been met. Section 3.2 mentions that copayments apply to each specialist office visit, but Section 3.9 discusses what happens after the out-of-pocket maximum is satisfied. Without additional evidence addressing this specific scenario, the finding cannot be made with certainty.
